India Celebrates National Doctors' Day, Focusing on Preventive Healthcare

National Doctors' Day in India is celebrated annually to honor the contributions of doctors and healthcare professionals. This year's theme focuses on preventive healthcare, highlighting the importance of early detection and treatment of diseases. The event brings together leading doctors, healthcare leaders, and policymakers to discuss strategies for improving healthcare outcomes.
